preconditions.description: k is an integer between 0 and 10,000 inclusive, and m is an integer between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split() if c.isdigit())
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two integers k and m separated by whitespace.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == 8 and line.isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is exactly 8 digits long.

postconditions.expression: all(any(eval(''.join([str(d) + op for d, op in zip(ticket, ops)]) + str(ticket[-1])) == int(k) for ops in generate_operators(ticket)) for ticket in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each ticket in the output, there exists a way to insert arithmetic operations ('+', '-', '*') and brackets between its digits such that the resulting arithmetic expression evaluates to k. The `generate_operators` function is a helper representing all possible valid operator/bracket combinations for the ticket.
